message.content: In the conversation, Li Hua expresses a positive sentiment towards the Blood and Wine expansion of The Witcher 3. Specifically, she describes the expansion as "incredible," highlighting the beauty of the new setting of Toussaint and the richness of the story. Li Hua also notes that the story feels like a mini-epic within itself, emphasizing the immersive nature of the quests and the engaging narrative. This indicates that Li Hua finds the Blood and Wine expansion to be a standout feature of the Witcher 3 experience, appreciating both the visual appeal and the depth of the storyline.
